notes.title: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven Available Today!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455640/

This game is a full remake of Romancing SaGa 2, the classic RPG from 1993 that sold a million copies in Japan.

The original game has been rebuilt with numerous accessibility updates to make it an exciting and enjoyable experience for SaGa series veterans and complete newcomers alike.

[b]■Story[/b]
Seven heroes saved the world in ages past, but the ancients feared their power and exiled them to another dimension.
Thousands of years have elapsed since The Seven were banished, and they have long passed into legend, but it was always said that they would return one day to save the world again.
Finally, they appear once more, but none can say what fate the heroes return will herald…

[b]■Imperial Succession[/b]
The player becomes the Emperors of Avalon and works to expand the realm while battling against the Seven Heroes. To stand against the incredible might of these foes, successive Emperors must pass their powers down the line of succession to their descendants and engage in an epic conflict that spans millennia. 

[b]■Characters[/b]
Over 30 different classes, featuring a plethora of races and occupations.
Each class has its own unique capabilities, favoured weapons and magical powers.
Characters from any class can ascend to become emperor.



[h3]Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven Demo available now![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065531/45ddb5a444af8cd2c63d3c774a37dd0016125964.png[/img]
The demo lets you enjoy the opening chapter of the game, where Emperor Leon and his comrades take on Kzinssie of the Seven Heroes. Story progress from the demo can be carried over to the full game.

notes.content:

Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven is a complete 3D remake of the original Romancing SaGa 2, first released in 1993 in Japan.

This remake keeps the epic story of the war fought between the imperial line of Varennes and the Seven Heroes of legend, as well as all the unique mechanics from the SaGa franchise, such as “Glimmers” and “Formations” while reworking the battle and character growth systems and adding numerous new features such as JP and EN voice acting. Moreover, the expansive world and characters that were originally depicted using pixel graphics have been fully updated to gorgeous 3D.

notes.title: A Message from the Developers
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790790/87fa14d233d9e88d7557887036b93ae6746dc7c5.jpg[/img]
[b]FORGE YOUR OWN TALE[/b]
The latest standalone entry in the SaGa franchise, SaGa Emerald Beyond brings together the very best elements of the beloved series to offer each player their own unique gameplay experience. Choose from five sets of lead characters and weave your own tale through 17 different worlds.
The full game is finally available today!
 
To celebrate the launch of the game, the SaGa Emerald Beyond developers came together to answer some of the communities hottest question in an interview style Q&A. 

[b]Is there any connection between the characters and setting of SaGa Emerald Beyond and past SaGa games?[/b] 
Series mainstays such as Glimmers and United Attacks are still present in SaGa Emerald Beyond, but there’s no connection in terms of the story and setting. Having said that, there might be some places that hit a little harder if you’ve played a title from the SaGa series before.
 
[b]Can you still enjoy SaGa Emerald Beyond without having played any other SaGa games?[/b] 
Yes - since there’s no connection to other titles in the series, you don’t need to have played any other SaGa games to enjoy Emerald Beyond.
There’s a demo available as well, so in case you’re unsure about this type of game, you could to start by playing the demo first.
 
[b]Which protagonist would you recommend for newcomers to the SaGa franchise, and which would you recommend for experts?[/b] 
Tsunanori Mido is fairly easy to get to grips with if you are new to all the different systems of SaGa. 
Whereas Bonnie and Formina might be more fun to play if you are already well versed in the series or after you’ve explored lots of different worlds with the other characters of SaGa Emerald Beyond, but if you like a challenge, of course there’s no problem with picking them first! 
 
[b]Do you have any tips for the battles?[/b]
The trick to having a successful battle is to connect the combo range of each individual tech.
In the beginning, just focus on trying to connect the green lines above all else. On top of that, it’s also important to try and disrupt enemy United Attacks.
 
[b]What kind of play time should I expect?[/b]
Starting with either of the 5 sets of protagonists, it takes a good few hours - around 10 - to reach your very first ending.
Each of the lead characters has a vastly different story and we developed the game in a way that you will never experience exactly the same thing twice. The story and ending will be different for each player, each playthrough - so play time can basically be infinite!
 
[b]Are you planning any DLC?[/b]
We don’t have any plans for DLC - but rest assured, there’s already plenty of content in SaGa Emerald Beyond.

With this we hope that you will be excited to dive into the divers worlds of SaGa Emerald Beyond. May your adventure be guided by the Emerald Wave!

notes.title: The wait is over! Saga Emerald Beyond is available now!
notes.content:
Make use of glimmers and combos in battle; meet a diverse cast of races, including monsters, mechs, and vampires; and experience your very own story, created through your choices and actions.

[b]Distant Worlds Woven Together:[/b]
Travel to 17 unique worlds from the Junction, either led by the hand of destiny or by a path forged by your own choices.
Discover the completely different cultures and landscapes, ranging from a densely developed forest of skyscrapers and a green and luscious habitat covered in plant life to a world governed by five witches, or one ruled by vampires - just to name a few of the distinct settings.

[b]An Eclectic Cast of Protagonists:[/b]
Six leading characters, all from diverse backgrounds and with vastly different goals, set out on their journey in five unique story arcs.
They venture to the myriad of worlds for their very own personal reasons: One, a human on a mission to protect the barrier defending his city; another, a witch trying to regain her lost magic while maintaining her disguise as a schoolgirl; and yet another, a vampire lord out to regain his crown and reclaim the throne as the rightful king of his world.
Even selecting the same protagonist for a second--or third or fourth--playthrough will lead to completely new events and stories, a completely fresh path and experience.

[b]TSUNANORI MIDO[/b]
A man who can manipulate kugutsu, animated puppets which bear their own will, and is tasked with protecting the barrier around his city! To achieve this Tsunanori is selected for the Cathedral Project to investigate other worlds and restore order to the spiritual realm.

[b]AMEYA AISLING[/b]
An up-and-coming witch who has hidden her true form under the guise of an elementary school girl! Determined to get her magical powers back, after losing them through an attack by an unknown man, and pass her witchterms, Ameya ventures out with her cat familiar LoLo.

[b]SIUGNAS[/b]
An immortal vampire who rules over a world shrouded in darkness, as the Dismal King! Betrayed and driven from his throne, when he awakens, Siugnas sets out on a journey to recover his powers, accompanied by the other warriors in his squadron.

[b]DIVA NO. 5[/b]
A mech designed to be the perfect entertainer! Capturing the hearts of all those who saw her perform, one day a forbidden song causes her memory and singing functionality to be sealed away. In her despair, Diva discards her “human” body and joins a secret society, leaving everything she had known behind.
And did you know, if you started Diva's journey in the free Steam Demo, you'll be able to carry your progress across to the full release?

[b]BONNIE BLAIR & FORMINA FRANKLYN[/b]
Two new recruits on the police force, investigating an assassination attempt! Former marine Bonnie, and renowned sharpshooter Formina set off on a journey together through the other worlds, to uncover the hidden truth behind the incident. 

[b]A Story of Your Very Own Making:[/b]
SaGa Emerald Beyond has the greatest number of branching plots of any game in the SaGa series.
The story branches abundantly depending on your choices and actions. Every time you visit a world, the story will evolve, allowing the protagonist and player alike to discover new possibilities.
As the story unfolds in this way it becomes a tale all of your own, not only affecting the path you walk but also the multiple potential endings that await each protagonist.

[b]Battles where a Single Choice Can Change Everything:[/b]
SaGa Emerald Beyond further refines the highly strategic Timeline Battles the SaGa franchise has been long renowned for. With series mainstays such as the skill to spontaneously acquire abilities through the Glimmer system, tactical ally placement known as Formations, and United Attacks that enable individual skills to connect together to form devastating chain attacks, it offers the best iteration of SaGa's turn-based combat to date.

The new combat system adds more drama than ever before, allowing you to support party members, interrupt enemy actions, and use United Attacks by strategically manipulating the order of ally actions.

The characters that join you, the weapons you wield, your party formation, and your tactics in battle - everything is up to you!

notes.title: SaGa SCARLET GRACE: AMBITIONS Out Now
notes.content:
The expanded version of the 2016 Japan-exclusive RPG SaGa SCARLET GRACE is out now for the first time in the west. SaGa SCARLET GRACE: AMBITIONS features enhanced graphics, character voiceovers, new skills to learn and even additional story. 

To celebrate the release of SaGa SCARLET GRACE: AMBITIONS, a 20% discount is available until [b]January 3, 2020 10:00 PST / 18:00 GMT. [/b]

[b]What is SaGa SCARLET GRACE: AMBITIONS?[/b]

SaGa SCARLET GRACE: AMBITIONS is an RPG that’s all about choice. 

It’s set in a world full of conflict and intrigue. The Firebringer, a fallen god and bane of humanity, wrought havoc on the planet. To survive, mankind built an Empire with one goal: defend humanity from this wicked creature.

But now, after a millennium of battle, the Firebringer has been defeated. Left without a unifying purpose, the Empire falls to rebellion. Amid the chaos, four adventurers set out on journeys that will change them and the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33188062/353dcfb01bcfcb11fbaada802ee121f05dde6191.jpg[/img]

As for where those journeys take them… that really depends on you. The Free Scenario System has become a fundamental part of the SaGa series. It featured in the recently released Romancing SaGa 3, and it’s out in full force here too. 

This system means that there’s no single fixed narrative in the game - instead, your specific adventure changes depending on who you choose to play as, and the decisions you make during their adventure.

As a result, the story you experience could very well be very different to others playing. What’s more, it strongly rewards a second, third or even fourth playthrough - and beyond. Honestly, few RPGs are as replayable as this.

Who are the characters of SaGa SCARLET GRACE: AMBITIONS?

Players can shape their own destiny with one of four exciting protagonists, each hero has their own unique storyline, allowing players to enjoy four different adventures in one game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33188062/4e06d153ff3123196c584c02e2e0e31d2de84305.jpg[/img]

The four protagonists are:

• [b]Urpina [/b]- the daughter of the noble Julanius family. Also known as the House of Swords, her family is considered to the head of the Empire’s four great warrior houses. When her home is attacked, and her family threatened, she takes up arms to defend them.

• [b]Leonard [/b]- a farmer from Yaxart - a frontier far from the heart of the Empire. One day he helps a dying woman who collapses on his farm. The event sends him on a path of danger and self-discovery. 

• [b]Balmaint [/b]- the legal executioner of Castle Kohan of Provincia Kei who follows in his family’s footsteps. A somewhat… unusual day on the job leaves him with a sense of unfinished business, and he sets off on a journey around the world to complete it.

• [b]Taria [/b]- a former witch who lives a calm life as a ceramicist. Her pottery reveals disturbances in the world, and she resolves to investigate the source of the problems.

While playing as one of these four characters, you’ll be able to recruit a party to support them in their cause. There are more than 70 potential allies - and who you recruit will depend on your main character and the path you take while playing.

notes.title: For the first time, Square Enix is releasing a game on Steam exclusively in Japanese
notes.content:
The last few years have shown that Square Enix is devoted to the PC, releasing nearly the entire Final Fantasy back catalog and new JRPGs like Final Fantasy 15 and Dragon Quest 11 that would've once been console exclusives. Now, in what may be a sign that Japan's PC audience is growing, Square Enix is taking a first step: releasing a game on Steam exclusively in Japanese, without it being region-locked to Japan. SaGa Scarlet Grace is launching on Steam on August 1st, side-by-side with its console versions.

As pointed out by Resetera, this is a new move for Square Enix, and SaGa Scarlet Grace is probably a good game to test the waters with. The SaGa series is infamously complex, borderline impenetrable, and several of its entries and remakes have never been released in the West. There's also a PC connection: the browser-based Imperial SaGa, also only available in Japanese, came out a few years ago.

In this case, it seems likely SaGa Scarlet Grace will get an English localization on PC, which may be why it's not region-locked to the Japanese store like some other games. Series creator Akitoshi Kawazu confirmed an English version was underway back in April, but it still has no planned release date. So for now, Scarlet Grace will serve as an interesting test case for how well Japanese RPGs can do on PC in their home region. 

Square Enix isn't the only Japanese developer to release games on Steam without English translations. Koei Tecmo has been doing so for years, releasing ports from its back catalog like Nobunaga's Ambition and Uncharted Waters. We'll see if this is a one-off for Square, or the start of a trend.
